changes.boundary: Eight existing side clips extended from -200 down to -1088in; two overlapping lower caps [-1120,-1024] added. Ceiling, horizontal footprint, original nine object/component identities preserved.
changes.controller: Unstuck free-candidate acceptance now rejects a playerclip crossing from the last known clear root, using the controller collision rules/ignore tags. Ordinary props remain escapable.

boundaryMovement.Scope: Actual HC1 MoveTo with and without step, 11 XY origins including corners and entrance joins, seven heights, 16 directions and three vertical slopes in the saved boundary-only scene. Does not cover spawn reachability, unstuck recovery or network corrections.

savedMapMovement.Scope: Actual HC1 MoveTo from all 32 saved standard spawns against the saved Military Outpost model colliders and boundary. Sixteen directions, three vertical slopes, step on/off. Not an exhaustive mantle/unstuck/explosion/network audit.

forcedOverlapBefore.Scope: Forced overlaps after a known valid interior position, using the actual controller recovery. Does not claim these penetrations can be reached from ordinary play.

forcedOverlapAfter.Scope: Forced overlaps after a known valid interior position, using the actual controller recovery. Does not claim these penetrations can be reached from ordinary play.

regressions.Scope: Regression checks: increased hull height under the cap, ordinary-prop recovery with/without known history, and explicit playerclip ignore. Isolated native controller checks, not a remote-client match.

limitations: Initial forced overlaps test recovery; they do not prove a normal spawn could reach the old leak.
Arbitrary external teleports/network corrections, exhaustive mantle/perch/explosion cases and remote-client play remain unverified.
